name: Shrivelling
text: Uses (4 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Fight. This attack uses [willpower] instead of [combat] and deals +1 damage. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this attack, take 1 horror.
text_cn: 使用(4充能)。 [action]花费1充能：攻击。本次攻击使用[willpower]代替[combat]，并造成+1伤害。如果本次攻击中揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]标记，受到1点恐惧。
